sports.title: Men’s 10m Air Rifle: Dhillon, Patil win silver, bronze; India’s shooting surge continues
sports.body: Himanshu Dhillon and Rudrankksh Patil added individual silver and bronze to India’s shooting haul at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, hours after helping the country win silver in the men’s 10m air rifle team event. Rudrankksh, who was part of India’s gold-medal winning team at Hangzhou, finished third after topping India’s qualification standings, while Himanshu secured silver as India continued its strong start in shooting.
